card.name: FR in GFR renal impairment cutoffs
card.fires_on: The letters FR completing GFR (and occasionally the cr in CLcr) inside a parenthesis after 'renal impairment', right before a cutoff such as <60 mL/min.

modes.label: GFR after renal impairment
modes.description: FR finishing GFR in the aliskiren warning about patients with renal impairment.
modes.example: Avoid use of aliskiren with valsartan tablets in patients with renal impairment (G<<FR>> less than 60 mL/min.)

modes.label: CLcr kidney function
modes.description: The cr of CLcr in a dosing restriction for severe kidney disease.
modes.example: Avoid use of JAKAFI/JAKAFI XR in patients with ESRD (CL<<cr>> less than 15 mL/min)

card.plain: It marks the end of the abbreviation GFR or CLcr just before a kidney function number.
